dialogues.jp: 「ただいまー」
dialogues.en:
It's just like the typical maid thing to do, and I can't
help myself from laughing.
dialogues.text:
It's just like the typical maid thing to do, and I can't
help myself from laughing.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、と、その……」

俺が床に埋まっているんじゃないかってくらい、
深々と頭を下げる。そして、俺の足下にきちん
とスリッパを揃えた。
dialogues.en: She slowly raises her head and looks up at me anxiously.
dialogues.text: She slowly raises her head and looks up at me anxiously.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、あの……」
dialogues.en: "......Is anything wrong?"
dialogues.text: "......Is anything wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
そろそろと顔を上げ、不安げに揺れる視線を送っ
てくる。
dialogues.en: "No, but you don't have to be so formal."
dialogues.text: "No, but you don't have to be so formal."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そんなかしこまらなくてもいいのに」
dialogues.en:
"When I say "I am home", all you have to say is "Hi,
Junichi!"."
dialogues.text:
"When I say "I am home", all you have to say is "Hi,
Junichi!"."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「“ただいま”って言ったら、“おかえり”っ
　て迎えてくれりゃ、それでいいんだよ」
dialogues.en: "......Hi, Junichi. Like this?"
dialogues.text: "......Hi, Junichi. Like this?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え、と、その……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, something like that. Just relax."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, something like that. Just relax."

dialogues.jp:
メイド服の下の身体は、ガチガチに固まってい
るように思えるのだった。
dialogues.en: I can tell her body under the maid uniform is so stiff.
dialogues.text: I can tell her body under the maid uniform is so stiff.

dialogues.jp: 「ふう……今日も一日疲れたっと」
dialogues.en: "Whew...... I'm tired today."
dialogues.text: "Whew...... I'm tired today."

dialogues.jp: 私服に着替え、首をぐるりと回す。
dialogues.en:
I take off my uniform and put on my plain clothes. I stretch
my neck.
dialogues.text:
I take off my uniform and put on my plain clothes. I stretch
my neck.

dialogues.jp:
にしても、やはり迎えてくれる人が居るっての
はいい事だ。
dialogues.en:
No matter what it's like, it's good to have someone to
welcome me home.
dialogues.text:
No matter what it's like, it's good to have someone to
welcome me home.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が家を出て、無人の家に帰るのがいかにつ
まらないかって、嫌ほど知ったからな。
dialogues.en:
Since Nemu moved out, I've learned how boring it is to come
back to an empty house.
dialogues.text:
Since Nemu moved out, I've learned how boring it is to come
back to an empty house.

dialogues.jp: 「あっと、そういや、洗濯物は取り込んだ？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I wonder if she took in the dry laundry?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I wonder if she took in the dry laundry?"

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの事だから、忘れてるって事は充分に
あり得るだろう。俺は、ベランダに向かった。
dialogues.en:
It's more likely that she's completely forgotten about it.
So I go to the veranda.
dialogues.text:
It's more likely that she's completely forgotten about it.
So I go to the veranda.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり」
dialogues.en: "I knew it."
dialogues.text: "I knew it."

dialogues.jp:
案の定、洗濯物は出しっぱなしだ。俺は早速、
取り込み始めた。
dialogues.en:
Just as I thought, the laundry's still outside. So I start
taking it inside.
dialogues.text:
Just as I thought, the laundry's still outside. So I start
taking it inside.

dialogues.jp: 「ん、これは……」
dialogues.en: "What is this......?"
dialogues.text: "What is this......?"

dialogues.jp:
俺のＹシャツに触ったところで、それに気が付
いた。
dialogues.en: I notice something when I touch my T-shirt.
dialogues.text: I notice something when I touch my T-shirt.

dialogues.jp:
もしや、他のも？　そう思い、風にパタパタと
はためく洗濯物を見渡す。
dialogues.en:
Are the others the same? I quickly look around at the other
clothes.
dialogues.text:
Are the others the same? I quickly look around at the other
clothes.

dialogues.jp:
果たして、全ての洗濯物がそうだった。つまり
──しわくちゃなのだ。
dialogues.en: And everything's the same. They're all wrinkled.
dialogues.text: And everything's the same. They're all wrinkled.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ……ま、しわくらいな」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm...... well, I can deal with wrinkles."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm...... well, I can deal with wrinkles."

dialogues.jp:
特におしゃれを自認している訳でもない俺は、
｛おうよう／鷹揚｝に笑ってみせる。
dialogues.en: I laugh about it because I'm not really a smart dresser.
dialogues.text: I laugh about it because I'm not really a smart dresser.

dialogues.jp: 「ざっはっは……は？」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha...... ha?"
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha...... ha?"

dialogues.jp:
ごひゅうと強い風が吹いたその時、俺の目の前
で洗濯物が旅立った。
dialogues.en:
As a strong wind blows, a cloth garment flies away in front
of me.
dialogues.text:
As a strong wind blows, a cloth garment flies away in front
of me.

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ日が傾いてきた青空に、俺のＴシャツ
がモモンガのごとく空を舞う。
dialogues.en:
Just like a sugar glider, my T-shirt is flying in the sky in
front of the almost-set sun.
dialogues.text:
Just like a sugar glider, my T-shirt is flying in the sky in
front of the almost-set sun.

dialogues.jp: あれは確か、お気に入りのシャツだったはず。
dialogues.en: That's my favorite T-shirt...
dialogues.text: That's my favorite T-shirt...

dialogues.jp: 「ざっはっは──ハァッ！」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha------ Ha!"
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha------ Ha!"

dialogues.jp:
思わず卒倒するくらいのスピードで洗濯物を屋
内に放り込むや否や、外に飛び出る俺が居た。
dialogues.en:
I take the laundry inside so quickly that I almost faint,
and then run outside.
dialogues.text:
I take the laundry inside so quickly that I almost faint,
and then run outside.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、と、その……えと……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I... am... umm..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I... am... umm..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「も、申し訳ありませんでした……」
dialogues.en: "I'm very sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I'm very sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
くにゃりと折れたネコ耳がストレートに感情を
表していて、何だか微笑ましいものがある。
dialogues.en:
Her cat ears are weakly bent down, honestly reflecting her
emotion. And I think it's kind of cute.
dialogues.text:
Her cat ears are weakly bent down, honestly reflecting her
emotion. And I think it's kind of cute.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、今度から気をつけてくれればいいよ。
　それに、ちゃんと説明しなかった俺も俺だ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, just please be careful from next time. And it's my
fault for not teaching you the details."
dialogues.text:
"Well, just please be careful from next time. And it's my
fault for not teaching you the details."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「い、いえ、そんな……。私が、私がみんな悪
　くて……」
dialogues.en: "N-No. It's not...... It's all my... my fault......"
dialogues.text: "N-No. It's not...... It's all my... my fault......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「まあまあ」
dialogues.en: "It's okay."
dialogues.text: "It's okay."

dialogues.jp:
ようやく息が整ってきて、まともに笑顔が浮か
べられる俺であった。
dialogues.en: I finally catch my breath and put a smile on my face.
dialogues.text: I finally catch my breath and put a smile on my face.

dialogues.jp: 例のＴシャツは、今は洗濯機の中だ。
dialogues.en: The T-shirt is back in the washing machine now.
dialogues.text: The T-shirt is back in the washing machine now.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとに……ほんとに、私……」
dialogues.en: "I am really...... really......"
dialogues.text: "I am really...... really......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「メイドとして……恥ずかしい……です」
dialogues.en: "I am really embarrassed...... as a maid......"
dialogues.text: "I am really embarrassed...... as a maid......"

dialogues.jp: いや、そんな悲痛な顔せんでも……。
dialogues.en: Oh, man. She looks really sad......
dialogues.text: Oh, man. She looks really sad......

dialogues.jp:
うつむき、唇をぎゅっとすぼめてテーブルを見
つめる顔は、何だか鬼気迫るものがある。
dialogues.en:
She's looking down at the table seriously, with her lips
tightly closed.
dialogues.text:
She's looking down at the table seriously, with her lips
tightly closed.

dialogues.jp: そこまで気にされると、逆に心苦しいのだが。
dialogues.en:
She cares about everything so much that it makes me feel bad
too.
dialogues.text:
She cares about everything so much that it makes me feel bad
too.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、あれだ。何事もプラス思考というか。
　いい運動になったと思えば」
dialogues.en:
"You know, positive thinking is very important. I think it
was a good exercise for me."
dialogues.text:
"You know, positive thinking is very important. I think it
was a good exercise for me."

dialogues.jp:
「そもそも俺なんて筋金入りの帰宅部で、運動
　不足も｛はなは／甚｝だしいからな」
dialogues.en:
"Plus, I haven't been in any club for a long time and I
really need to exercise anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Plus, I haven't been in any club for a long time and I
really need to exercise anyway."

dialogues.jp:
「そんな訳で、この話はひとまず終わり。で、
　いいね？」
dialogues.en: "So, that's it for this. Okay?"
dialogues.text: "So, that's it for this. Okay?"

dialogues.jp:
意識してカラっとした声を出す。頼子さんはそ
ろそろと顔をあげると、はいと頷いた。
dialogues.en:
I deliberately try to sound bright and positive. Yoriko-san
slowly raises her head and nods in agreement.
dialogues.text:
I deliberately try to sound bright and positive. Yoriko-san
slowly raises her head and nods in agreement.

dialogues.jp:
「さて、じゃあ失敗は脇に置いといて、と。明
　日のためのその１と行きますか」
dialogues.en:
"Let's take a lesson from a failure for tomorrow. So, Lesson
1."
dialogues.text:
"Let's take a lesson from a failure for tomorrow. So, Lesson
1."

dialogues.jp: 「ではまず、洗濯物を干す前にやる事……」
dialogues.en: "Before you hang laundry outside to dry......"
dialogues.text: "Before you hang laundry outside to dry......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「なるほど……干す前に、洗濯物を伸ばすので
　すね……」
dialogues.en:
"I see...... I have to stretch the laundry before hanging
it."
dialogues.text:
"I see...... I have to stretch the laundry before hanging
it."

dialogues.jp:
真剣な顔で、俺の言った事を復唱し動作を真似
る。
dialogues.en:
With a serious look on her face, she repeats what I told her
and imitates the action I showed her.
dialogues.text:
With a serious look on her face, she repeats what I told her
and imitates the action I showed her.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうすれば、しわにならずに乾く……」
dialogues.en: "If you do this, they won't get wrinkled when they dry."
dialogues.text: "If you do this, they won't get wrinkled when they dry."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……次からは、そうします……」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... I'll do this next time......"
dialogues.text: "Oh...... I'll do this next time......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、その……お、教えていただいて……あり
　がとうございます……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, th-thank you so much for...... teaching me all this."
dialogues.text: "Ah, th-thank you so much for...... teaching me all this."

dialogues.jp:
その視線にはほのかな尊敬が含まれているよう
で、少し心苦しい。何せ、俺のは音夢の受け売
りに過ぎないのだ。
dialogues.en:
She looks at me with some kind of respect in her eyes, and I
feel bad. Because all I taught her is how to do laundry, and
I learned that from Nemu.
dialogues.text:
She looks at me with some kind of respect in her eyes, and I
feel bad. Because all I taught her is how to do laundry, and
I learned that from Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ……エヘン」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... Ahem."
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... Ahem."

dialogues.jp:
照れ隠しに咳払いなんぞして、明日のためのそ
の２につなぐ。
dialogues.en:
I clear my throat just to hide my embarrassment and continue
to Lesson 2.
dialogues.text:
I clear my throat just to hide my embarrassment and continue
to Lesson 2.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、次は干し方ね。これは、実地にやって
　みた方がいいか」
dialogues.en:
"Next thing is how to hang a laundry on a clothesline. I
think we should actually do it and learn."
dialogues.text:
"Next thing is how to hang a laundry on a clothesline. I
think we should actually do it and learn."

dialogues.jp:
ベランダに出ると、もう外は茜色の薄暗さに包
まれていた。
dialogues.en:
As we go out to the veranda, the sky's reddening and getting
darker.
dialogues.text:
As we go out to the veranda, the sky's reddening and getting
darker.

dialogues.jp:
どこからかカラスの鳴き声が聞こえてきて、変
にもの悲しい。
dialogues.en:
I hear a crow cawing in the sky, and I feel a little bit
lonely for some reason.
dialogues.text:
I hear a crow cawing in the sky, and I feel a little bit
lonely for some reason.

dialogues.jp:
「ポイントは、きちんと洗濯物を固定する事。
　でないと、飛んでいっちゃうからね」
dialogues.en:
"The important thing is to hang the laundry tightly, or the
wind will blow it away."
dialogues.text:
"The important thing is to hang the laundry tightly, or the
wind will blow it away."

dialogues.jp:
二人も居ると狭苦しいベランダで、俺達は向か
いあった。
dialogues.en:
The veranda's too small for two people and we're standing
face to face.
dialogues.text:
The veranda's too small for two people and we're standing
face to face.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、子どもっぽさの漂うような真剣さ
で、耳を傾けている。
dialogues.en: Yoriko-san's listening very carefully, like a little child.
dialogues.text: Yoriko-san's listening very carefully, like a little child.

dialogues.jp:
夕焼けを受けたメイド服の少女は、絵から抜け
だしでもしてきたように、綺麗だ。
dialogues.en:
This girl in a maid costume looks so beautiful with the
sunset on her back.
dialogues.text:
This girl in a maid costume looks so beautiful with the
sunset on her back.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの……固定するには……？」
dialogues.en: "Ah... how do I hang it tightly......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah... how do I hang it tightly......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、うん、固定の仕方ね」
dialogues.en: "......Oh, umm... how to hang it tightly... right."
dialogues.text: "......Oh, umm... how to hang it tightly... right."

dialogues.jp:
ふっと抜け出ていった意識を引っ張り戻し、話
を再開する。
dialogues.en:
My mind's floating in the air. I pull myself together and
continue my lesson.
dialogues.text:
My mind's floating in the air. I pull myself together and
continue my lesson.

dialogues.jp: 「洗濯バサミがそこに置いてあるからさ」
dialogues.en: "There are clothespins over there."
dialogues.text: "There are clothespins over there."

dialogues.jp:
と、エアコンの室外機の上にある小さなカゴを
指差す。
dialogues.en:
And I point out the little box on an air conditioning
outside motor.
dialogues.text:
And I point out the little box on an air conditioning
outside motor.

dialogues.jp: 「洗濯物に合わせて、適当な大きさの奴を──」
dialogues.en:
"According to the size of clothes, use the one with the
right size......"
dialogues.text:
"According to the size of clothes, use the one with the
right size......"

dialogues.jp: ひゅう……！
dialogues.en: (A wind blows)
dialogues.text: (A wind blows)

dialogues.jp:
声が、かき消された。ひときわ強い春風が、頼
子さんのキャップを吹き飛ばした。
dialogues.en:
My voice is blown away by the wind. And the very strong
spring wind blows Yoriko-san's hat off.
dialogues.text:
My voice is blown away by the wind. And the very strong
spring wind blows Yoriko-san's hat off.

dialogues.jp:
彼女の手が、キャップを追う。しかし、｛わず／僅｝かの
差で指先を逃れ、キャップは空へ。
dialogues.en:
She tries to grab her hat, stretching out with her hand, but
it's an inch too far, and it flies into the sky.
dialogues.text:
She tries to grab her hat, stretching out with her hand, but
it's an inch too far, and it flies into the sky.

dialogues.jp:
そして、伸び上がった勢いのまま、頼子さんは
バランスを崩した。
dialogues.en: And as she tries to reach further, she loses her balance.
dialogues.text: And as she tries to reach further, she loses her balance.

dialogues.jp:
大して広くもないベランダなのだ。ふたりも居
れば、狭苦しく感じるくらいの。
dialogues.en: The veranda isn't big enough for two people.
dialogues.text: The veranda isn't big enough for two people.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おっと」
dialogues.en: "OH!"
dialogues.text: "OH!"

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんの身体が俺の腕の中に収まっていた。
dialogues.en: Yoriko-san's body is in my arms.
dialogues.text: Yoriko-san's body is in my arms.

dialogues.jp: とても、柔らかい。
dialogues.en: It's so soft.
dialogues.text: It's so soft.

dialogues.jp:
初めに感じたのは、それだった。そして、それ
に相反するように、全体的にはとても｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝だ。
dialogues.en:
That's the first thing I feel. And her whole body's so
delicate.
dialogues.text:
That's the first thing I feel. And her whole body's so
delicate.

dialogues.jp:
一瞬を、ひどく長く感じた。二人は今、恋愛映
画のワンシーンのように、抱き合っている。
dialogues.en:
The one moment seems to stretch into minutes. We're holding
each other just like in a scene of a romance movie.
dialogues.text:
The one moment seems to stretch into minutes. We're holding
each other just like in a scene of a romance movie.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ご、ごめんなさい！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I'm sorry!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I'm sorry!"

dialogues.jp:
感触が、泡のようにぱっと消えた。少し遅れて、
“惜しい”という感情を認識する。
dialogues.en:
The soft feeling in my arms quickly disappears like a bubble
bursting. Then after a few seconds, I realize that I hated
to let it go.
dialogues.text:
The soft feeling in my arms quickly disappears like a bubble
bursting. Then after a few seconds, I realize that I hated
to let it go.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、夕映えの中でもそれと、はっきり
分かるくらい、真っ赤に赤面していた。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san, on the other hand -- her face is as red as the
sunset.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san, on the other hand -- her face is as red as the
sunset.

dialogues.jp:
それから、けつまずきながらも、スカートの下
のペチコートを覗かせつつ、彼女はベランダを
出ていったのだった。
dialogues.en:
And she trips a little and runs back out from the veranda,
showing the petticoat under her skirt.
dialogues.text:
And she trips a little and runs back out from the veranda,
showing the petticoat under her skirt.

dialogues.jp: 「……洗濯物、取り込んで置いて良かった」
dialogues.en: "......It's a good thing I already took the laundry in."
dialogues.text: "......It's a good thing I already took the laundry in."

dialogues.jp:
怠っていたら雪だるまのように、洗濯物にくる
まれていたかもしれない。あの勢いからすると。
dialogues.en:
Or she'd have probably been rolled up in the laundry when
she tripped over like that.
dialogues.text:
Or she'd have probably been rolled up in the laundry when
she tripped over like that.

dialogues.jp: ぢっと手を見る。
dialogues.en: I look at my hands closely.
dialogues.text: I look at my hands closely.

dialogues.jp:
有名人と握手した奴が、手を洗いたくないと思
う心境が、何となく理解出来た。
dialogues.en:
I can understand now how a guy who doesn't want to wash his
hand after shaking hands with a famous celebrity feels.
dialogues.text:
I can understand now how a guy who doesn't want to wash his
hand after shaking hands with a famous celebrity feels.

dialogues.jp: 「……風呂入らない訳にもいかないしな……」
dialogues.en: "......But I have to take a shower......"
dialogues.text: "......But I have to take a shower......"

dialogues.jp: それは人間として失うものが大きすぎる。
dialogues.en: But it's too big to lose.
dialogues.text: But it's too big to lose.

dialogues.en: "Sigh."
dialogues.text: "Sigh."

dialogues.jp:
ベッドにごろんと横になると、真っ白なペチコー
トが目の前にちらついたのだった。
dialogues.en: I lie down on my bed and think about the white petticoat.
dialogues.text: I lie down on my bed and think about the white petticoat.

dialogues.jp: ◆ベランダにて◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
洗濯機は滞りなく使えたようだが、今度はその
先、洗濯物の干し方。
dialogues.en: I hear elegant running footsteps coming closer.
dialogues.text: I hear elegant running footsteps coming closer.

dialogues.jp:
ベランダに出て干し方をレクチャーするも、突
然の風に、頼子さんのキャップが飛ばされてし
まう。

慌てて手を伸ばした頼子さんだがバランスを崩
し、狭いベランダで二人抱き合う格好に……。
dialogues.en: "Welcome home, sir......"
dialogues.text: "Welcome home, sir......"

dialogues.jp: 真っ赤に赤面して慌てて離れた頼子さんだった。
dialogues.en:
She bows her head all the way down, as if I was standing
under the ground. And she puts a pair of slippers in front
